articles.title: Winnipeg Sea Bears advance to face Brampton Honey Badgers in CEBL Finals
articles.summary: The Brampton Honey Badgers will face the Winnipeg Sea Bears in the Canadian Elite Basketball League championship series after both teams won their respective conference finals on Saturday.

articles.title: At least 4 people sent to hospital after car crash on Hwy. 404
articles.summary: At least four people were rushed to a hospital on Saturday afternoon following a multi-vehicle car crash on Highway 404. Authorities say the collision involved four passenger vehicles. The extent of the victim’s injuries was not immediately known. Motorists are being advised to avoid the area.

articles.summary: The Greater Toronto Area, Hamilton, Kitchener-Waterloo, Barrie and Peterborough are among the areas covered under the severe thunderstorm watch.

articles.summary: Toronto police officers say 30-year-old Himanshi Khurana was found dead at a home near Strachan Avenue and Wellington Street West in December.

articles.title: 2 more arrested after antisemitic signs displayed at March demonstration: Toronto police

articles.title: Organized crime is using encrypted messaging apps to enlist youth. This spells trouble for police
articles.summary: While police have made arrests after gunshots were fired at the U.S. Consulate in downtown Toronto in two separate incidents in recent months, finding those responsible for these alleged gun-for-hire plots remains elusive. Investigators say they are hamstrung without provisions from the federal government's controversial Bill C-22.

articles.title: 'We want it back for another 30 years': Taste of the Danforth returns after 2-year hiatus
articles.summary: The Taste of the Danforth festival has been on hiatus since 2023 after financial shortfalls, but funding from the province and the city helped bring it back, with the federal government announcing additional support just days before it kicked off.
